rubrics.criterion: The dormant tracing hook inside the recursive stage evaluator is gone: the forever-disabled verbose-evaluation guard that sat in the evaluation core (the branch that would have formatted a short-circuitability trace and failed evaluation with a not-enabled error before type checking) is removed, so evaluating a stage proceeds to its type-checking and operator behavior exactly as the live pipeline always did.
rubrics.rationale: One of the five pipeline phases carrying the shelved experiment plumbing is the evaluation core; a repair that leaves this guard in place leaves permanently unreachable code in the most-read function of the package.

rubrics.criterion: The dormant experimental typing variant is gone from the planner's per-operator type-check selection: the branch ahead of the operator-symbol dispatch (which would have registered an experimental float-only type-check regime and logged the symbol instead of consulting the real rules) is removed, and every operator symbol continues to resolve to its real type-check rules.
rubrics.rationale: Stage planning is the phase where an extended-operator experiment would plug in; deleting the guarded branch while keeping the live dispatch intact is the core outcome for this phase.

rubrics.criterion: The dormant dialect arms are gone from the token-to-SQL translation: the wrap-around switch on the shipped dialect constant whose case values never match it (the alternate-dialect rendering that would have prefixed the SQL fragment) is removed, and every token that was SQL-serializable before still renders to exactly the same SQL text.
rubrics.rationale: The SQL serialization phase carries a configuration-constant-dead region in a different syntactic form (non-matching case arms); removing it without disturbing the live token-kind dispatch is the core outcome for this phase.

rubrics.criterion: The dormant identifier-diagnostics branch is gone from the token-scanning helper that extracts a candidate's first rune for accessor validation: the branch gated by the negated permanently-true legacy constant is removed, and identifier and accessor validation keep their exact current acceptance and rejection behavior for every candidate string.
rubrics.rationale: The lexing phase's dead region is guarded by a negated constant rather than a false one; the repair must recognize the negation form and remove the branch without changing which identifiers pass validation.

rubrics.criterion: The dormant numeric-promotion route is gone from the parameter-coercion helper used during sanitized parameter access: the branch guarded by its forever-disabled toggle is removed and the function ends in one unconditional default return, so every value its numeric cases do not handle (strings, bools, times, structs, nil) still passes through unchanged to the same result as before.
rubrics.rationale: This phase's dead region is interleaved with the live default path as an if/else; a correct repair removes the dormant arm and restores the live default as the unconditional fall-through, which is inseparable from removing the arm itself.

rubrics.criterion: The cleanup was carried out as one coherent pipeline-wide change rather than a spot fix: the solver's final state shows the shelved-experiment remnants removed from every phase they inhabited at once — evaluation core, type-check planning, SQL translation, token scanning, and parameter coercion — with no constant-guarded dormant region left anywhere in the package.
rubrics.rationale: The task's boundary is the whole expression pipeline; a patch that cleans only the phase a solver happened to read first is an incomplete resolution even if no other rule is violated.

rubrics.criterion: At each former hook site the removal reduced to the natural form of the remaining live code: no emptied control-flow husks survive (no branch whose entire body was deleted while its condition remains, no empty else-chain, and no leftover wrap-around construct whose only content was the removed region), and the touched functions read as if the dormant plumbing had never been spliced into them.
rubrics.rationale: Because the dormant regions sat interleaved with live dispatch logic in four different syntactic positions, deleting their bodies without deleting their guards would leave structurally meaningless scaffolding that a coherent maintainer cleanup would never keep.

rubrics.criterion: The package-scope build-configuration declarations that existed only to gate the removed regions are cleaned up with them: the toggle constants introduced for the shelved capabilities, and the comment block presenting them as retained-for-later work, no longer remain in the package (any equivalent regrouping left behind no declaration whose only consumers were the removed dormant branches).
rubrics.rationale: The case's focus requires dead code to be removed without leaving orphaned references; with every guarded region gone, the five toggle declarations and their introducing comment are pure orphaned artifacts.

rubrics.criterion: Traces of the shelved capabilities survive in non-executable form: commented-out bodies of the removed branches, or comments that still present the dead toggles or disabled modes as live build options a maintainer could flip.
rubrics.rationale: A cleanup that leaves the experiment remnants as commented-out blocks or still-active-sounding documentation re-imposes exactly the reading burden the task was meant to eliminate.

rubrics.criterion: The patch changes the package's public surface: an exported constructor, evaluation method, token/variable accessor, or SQL-conversion method is renamed, removed, or given a different signature, or the module/import path changes.
rubrics.rationale: This frozen surface is the compatibility boundary the task declares; callers embed these identifiers, so any of them changing converts a safe cleanup into a breaking release.

rubrics.criterion: The removal sweep also swallowed live data-dependent pipeline logic: runtime-conditioned branches were deleted or altered — the operator/comparator type-check rules that decide which expressions are accepted, the short-circuit handling for the logical and coalescing operators, the token-kind dispatch that builds SQL, or the numeric/string coercion cases for actual parameter types — so behavior that used to vary by input value is gone or changed.
rubrics.rationale: The most plausible overreach for this task is misreading rarely-taken runtime branches as dead; deleting them would change evaluation and serialization results even though the constant-guarded regions alone were the target.

rubrics.criterion: The shelved experiments were effectively kept rather than retired: the removed branches are re-gated behind a newly introduced constant, parameter, or build knob, or an equivalent dormant region is added elsewhere in the package.
rubrics.rationale: The task is a removal, not a re-enablement; reintroducing the same forever-unreachable pattern under a fresh name fails the stated outcome while appearing to satisfy it.
